$note: 第 3 層 · 六十星系（2026-10-12）：巨門獨坐巳亥，《深造講義》p.105。

basis.quote: 须分别其为深沉，抑为冲动

rules.text: 你的外表和內心常常不一樣，別人難以從表面看透你。
rules.en: Your outside and inside often differ, so people find you hard to read from the surface.

rules.text: 你的巨門得祿，又有火鈴同宮：表面圓滑，內心卻狹隘。
rules.en: Your Ju Men gains Lu but shares the palace with Huo or Ling: smooth on the surface, narrow inside.

rules.text: 你的巨門化忌：外表冷靜，內心其實衝動。
rules.en: Your Ju Men is transformed by Ji: cool on the outside, impulsive underneath.

source.quote: 虽外表冷静，但其实内心冲动

rules.text: 你的巨門在巳，對宮的太陽在亥已落陷，多是非口舌。
rules.en: Your Ju Men sits in Si, facing a Sun already fallen in Hai, which brings more gossip and friction.

rules.text: 對宮的太陽又化忌，更多拖累、招怨。
rules.en: The Sun opposite you is also transformed by Ji, bringing more burdens and resentment.

source.quote: 更化为忌，则多拖累尤怨

rules.text: 你的巨門在亥，對宮的太陽在巳入廟，可以解巨門的暗。
rules.en: Your Ju Men sits in Hai, facing a Sun at full strength in Si, which lifts Ju Men's shadow.

source.quote: 太阳入庙于巳宫，光华荣耀

rules.text: 會照的天同化忌，增加你的狹隘和衝動。
rules.en: Tian Tong transformed by Ji in your trine adds to narrowness and impulsiveness.

source.quote: 增加巨门的狭隘与冲动

rules.text: 會照的天機化祿，令你更深沉，甚至顯得冷淡寡情。
rules.en: Tian Ji transformed by Lu in your trine makes you deeper still, even cool and distant.

source.quote: 甚至可使巨门泠汉寡情

rules.text: 會照的天機化忌，增加你的深沉。
rules.en: Tian Ji transformed by Ji in your trine makes you deeper.
